Raw_Title: Automate Match Workbench Voucher Error Notifications
Item (REQUIRED): Automate Match Workbench Voucher Error Notifications
Description_Raw:
With resources continuing to be strained, UTA is exploring opportunities to automate system driven notifications to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency. Within Accounts Payable, vouchers with match exceptions require user action before payment can proceed; however, users are not consistently or clearly notified when these errors occur. Upon review of the Match Workbench, UTA identified an existing notification capability that can alert users when vouchers contain match errors. Testing in Production confirmed that this functionality is already configured, but it is not currently automated or optimized for regular use. When notifications are sent, they rely on numeric error codes that do not clearly explain the issue, limiting their effectiveness. This issue primarily affects departmental users responsible for resolving voucher issues, as well as Accounts Payable staff who must manually monitor match exceptions and follow up when vouchers remain unresolved. As a result, vouchers may sit in error status longer than necessary, contributing to delayed payments and increased manual workload. This idea was triggered by the need to improve visibility into match errors, reduce reliance on manual follow up, and support more timely payment processing. Addressing this problem now allows UTA to better leverage existing system functionality, improve user understanding of match issues, and mitigate payment delays without introducing significant customization.
